source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.4 with Figs. 9.14 and 9.15 (PDF 200-201).

blocks.text: Maan lein point charges q₁, q₂, q₃, …, qₙ kisi bhi shakal ki band (closed) surface ke andar kahin bhi rakhe hain (Fig. 9.14). Har charge q ka flux q/ε₀ hai, is liye band surface se kul flux:

blocks.alt: Be-qaida gulabi band surface jis ke andar saat chhote narangi point charges q1, q2, q3, q4, q5, q6 aur qn.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.14 (kitab ki Figure 9.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har charge apna flux q/ε₀ deta hai; kul flux sab ka jor (q₁ + q₂ + … + qₙ)/ε₀ = Q/ε₀ hai. Surface ke bahar wale charges kul flux mein kuch nahi jorte: un ki jo line andar aati hai wohi bahar nikal jati hai.

blocks.text_alt: φₑ = (1/ε₀) × (band surface ke andar kul charge)

blocks.text: Yahan Q = q₁ + q₂ + q₃ + … + qₙ band surface ke andar kul charge hai. Eq. 9.14 Gauss's law ki mathematical shakal hai. Lafzon mein:

blocks.title: Gauss's law
blocks.text: Kisi bhi band surface se kul electric flux us ke andar band kul charge ka 1/ε₀ guna hota hai.
